summary: Improve complaint workflows, investigations, redress and trend reporting. Explore this practical financial services complaint handling course.
lede: Financial services complaint handling training helps complaint officers and customer-operations or conduct-risk teams build consistent case workflows. Participants practise classifying and escalating complaints, documenting evidence-based investigations and redress, and using Five Whys and Pareto analysis to identify recurring causes and guide corrective action. They also work with complaint records, control responsibilities and performance dashboards, informed by ISO 10002:2018 and the OECD/G20 principles.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for financial-sector professionals who handle, oversee, investigate, control or report on customer complaints. It suits people with working exposure to banking, digital credit or related financial services operations who need more consistent workflows and stronger use of complaint data.
audience: Financial Ombuds and Redress Case Officers
modules: Five Whys for Complaint Root Causes
prerequisites: Working familiarity with financial-services customer operations, complaint handling, conduct risk, compliance or internal audit is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Exercises use complaint-case examples and spreadsheet calculations; participants may use Excel or an equivalent spreadsheet tool.
